description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer inactive-control checkpoint: the safe host VT writer discards exactly the C0 controls Microsoft classifies as inactive without changing cursor position or row contents.

entries.notes: HostWriteState::write_vt filters Microsoft's exact 24 inactive C0 ordinals (0-7, 14-25, 28-31). The direct witness reproduces the native single-control, repeated-control, control-before-text and controls-between-text cases for every ordinal, proving no write/cursor movement beyond printable text.
